title: Mother Holding 8-Week-Old Baby, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Don't ask me who she is mad at!!
8 wks old

A07351
description: A candid black and white snapshot from the early 1960s showing a mother holding her eight-week-old baby outdoors against a cinder-block wall background. The baby is wrapped in a light shirt and a hand-crocheted blanket, looking intently into the camera with a stern expression that inspired the humorous note written on the back.
